title: M6 Source Guard Strategy — Bounded Evolution Without Wildcard Allowlist

per_work_item_provenance.mechanism: Each work item (M6-1..M6-6, M6-R) records its authorized paths, expected output, acceptance, and evidence marker; integration provenance is recorded separately in M6-6

integration_provenance.mechanism: M6-6 records integration evidence showing ownership non-overlap and that no two lanes raced on same canonical contract file

future_sensitive_post_m6_rejection.mechanism: Guard rejects mutations outside the explicitly enumerated authorized path sets; uses positive enumeration, not negative exclusion

wildcard_rejection.detail_no_wildcard: no aota_forge/** or aota_forge/core/** wildcard is allowed; each production file is individually enumerated
wildcard_rejection.detail_no_blanket: no tests/test_m6_*.py blanket bypass; each test file is individually enumerated and must correspond to owning work item
wildcard_rejection.detail_scoped: deploy/evidence/issues/9/m6-*/* is scoped to m6-* prefix, not deploy/**

strategy.evolution_from_m5: M5 guard allowed aota_forge/** in some scopes with contract checks; M6 tightens to explicit per-file enumeration for new Codex and dispatcher changes while preserving frozen M5 paths as read-only

regression_obligations_retained.source_guard: 34/34 baseline preserved; M6 extends with new checks; no wildcard
